notes.title: 🎉 New Major Update: Forgotten Trials! 🎉
notes.content:
[p]This update brings fresh content, gameplay improvements, and fixes to keep the bounce going strong. [/p][p]Here's what's new:[/p][p][b]New Bonus Area: Forgotten Trials
[/b]Head to the overworld and discover [i]Forgotten Trials[/i] — a hidden set of 3 all-new single-player levels! Can you conquer these secret challenges?[/p][p][b]New Platform Type for More Platforming Madness
[/b]Introducing the [i]Jump Flip Panel[/i], a tricky new platform that toggles on or off every time you jump. Master the timing to survive![/p][p][b]Level Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Made the way forward clearer in [i]Level 1 – Cellar Labyrinth[/i] and [i]Level 2 – Cave Rave[/i].

[/p][/*][*][p]New popup at the start of a new game lets you choose assist mode presets or customize your settings right away.

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Multiplayer Tweaks
[/b]We’ve reduced the number of multiplayer server regions to help gather more players on the same servers for finding other players more easily.[/p][p][b]Other Enhancements[/b][/p][list][*][p]UI elements now have clearer borders for better visibility.

[/p][/*][*][p]Internal systems updated to support the new bonus area and multiplayer plugin improvements.

[/p][/*][*][p]"Write a Review" popup can now appear after completing a level — let us know what you think!

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where arms on skins appeared incorrectly on characters with extra bones at the wardrobe.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where player ghosts could become brighter than intended after certain types of damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Audio logging fixed in the final scene.[/p][/*][*][p]News articles now display in the correct order.[/p][/*][*][p]And more small polish and cleanup![/p][/*][/list][p]As always, thank you for playing [i]Stilt[/i]! 💚[/p][p]Want to share feedback or connect with others? Join us on Discord:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/mYy9Z8axEm"]https://discord.gg/mYy9Z8axEm[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: STILT Easter Egg Hunt Update!
notes.content:
Get ready to bounce into spring! STILT just got an egg-citing seasonal update—available now on all platforms!

New Easter Egg Hunt

We’ve hidden colorful Easter eggs throughout the game—1 golden ticket egg in every one of the 20 levels!

Collect tickets to unlock awesome rewards!

Improved eye textures for all skins—looking smoother and more expressive than ever!

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Squashed a minor audio log spam bug for a cleaner experience.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where pausing during the boss fight could cause missiles to get stuck, leading to physics bugs and broken ground collision on some consoles.

[/list]
Hop back in, start hunting, and don’t forget to show off your new look once you’ve claimed your rewards! Tag us with your favorite outfit!

notes.title: Winterland Rescue Awaits in Stilt’s Xmas Update!
notes.content:
The holiday season arrives in Stilt with Update 1.9.0!

Xmas fun!

🎄 Winterland Rescue Event: Team up to help a rabbit deliver a star to the Christmas tree while fending off mischievous snowmen in this festive multiplayer challenge.
🎅 Seasonal Style: Unlock 9 exclusive Christmas-themed cosmetics to celebrate in style.
❄ Winter Wonderland Lobby: Immerse yourself in holiday cheer with snowy decorations and a seasonal main menu.

New Lobby Meetup Timer!
⏱️ Easily connect with others during scheduled meetups with our new timer feature. Let’s make finding players a breeze!

Fixes and improvements
[list]
[*] Smoother movement with improved player position synchronization over the network.
[*] Enhanced synchronization for the hookshot power-up
[*] Fixed network time hiccup on connection
[/list]

Get ready to bounce into the holiday spirit! 

The whole Stilt team from Rekt Games and VRKiwi wish you all a joyful holiday season with this Stilt Christmas update!

notes.title: Stilt Patch Update 1.8.0 and 1.8.1
notes.content:
Hey Stilt players! 🎃 We’re thrilled to see how many of you joined us for the Halloween update, diving into the spooky areas and taking on the eerie challenges. Good news — you still have time to enjoy the Crystal Hunt in the Halloween area, even with these new patch update fixes!

Thank you for the amazing feedback; it’s been invaluable in making Stilt even better! We’re releasing patches 1.8.0 and 1.8.1 to fix some unfortunate bugs from the previous update. We’re genuinely sorry for any frustration caused and are excited to keep Stilt running smoothly so you can focus on the fun and thrills.

[b]Here’s what’s fixed in the latest patches:[/b]

1.8.0
General Changes

[Improvement] The intro logo section at startup is now skippable.

[Improvement] Lip-syncing is now visible in mirrors for preview.

[Fix] Resolved blend shape normal issues on the three new Halloween skins.

[Fix] Fixed various minor issues to enhance overall stability.

[Other] Internal upgrades for crash reporting and debugging.


1.8.1
General Changes

[Fix] Fixed out-of-sync lookup table for spawnable objects, causing incorrect objects to spawn in certain actions, leading to errors, crashes, and unintended behavior.

[Fix] Addressed an issue where a microphone could be requested despite none being available.


[b]As always, keep sharing your experiences and feedback![/b] We’re committed to making Stilt an unforgettable adventure, and we couldn’t do it without you. Stay tuned for even more exciting updates on the horizon!

-The Stilt team

notes.title: 🎉 Stilt 1.6.0 is LIVE! 🎉
notes.content:
🎨 New Multiplayer Mode: Color Splash

Jump into Color Splash, our brand-new multiplayer mode! Dive into the action, paint everything in sight, and compete to cover the most ground before time runs out. It’s fast, it’s fun, and it’s the ultimate test of agility and creativity!

Quality of Life Updates

🛠️ Improvements for clarity
[list]
[*] Door Progress Tracking: New progress counters above doors let you know how close you are to unlocking the next area by defeating enemies in the current section.
[*] Level Adjustments: Finding the exit in Level 19 - Lava Mystery just got simpler.
[*] Boss Battle: Rising platforms in boss battle are now more intuitive.
[*] Assist Mode Tip: If you’re having a tough time, we’ll suggest activating assist mode.
[/list]
🌴 New improved comfort
[list]
[*] Head-locked screens: Game over and score screens are less head-locked for smoother viewing.
[*] Better level transitions: New audio effect and transition fade to black instead of white, enhancing visual comfort and flow.
[/list]
💙 Community request 
[list]
[*] Multiplayer Improvements: Added walls around the arena in Floor Pop mode to prevent early punch outs.
[/list]
🐞 Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] No more getting stuck inside locked doors.
[*] Fixed icon alignment on level portals—stamp rewards are now properly displayed on the left side with the rest of the stamp information.
[*] Buttons meant to be pressed once can no longer be activated multiple times.
[*] Portals in levels and gameplay are now triggered only by the player’s head, not the stilts.
[*] Resolved a bug where the sliding puzzle cube could clip into walls.
[*] Fixed issues with cloud platforms in Windmill Hills.
[*] Addressed a bug where the game could appear frozen due to pausing during a loading screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where looping audio persisted between scenes if the game was paused during a scene transition.
[/list]

We hope you have an absolute blast bouncing through Color Splash and exploring all the new improvements! Your input helps us make Stilt even better, so if you’re enjoying the game, we’d love for you to leave a rating or review. It makes a huge difference!

notes.title: Patch 1.4.0 - Customize Your Challenge
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Stilt players! [/h1]
We're excited to bring you our latest update, packed with new features, improvements, and fixes to make your gaming experience even better. Here's what's new in version 1.4.0.

[h2][h1]New Features 🚀[/h1][/h2]

[h3][h2]Assist Mode: Tailor Your Adventure[/h2][/h3]
[list]
[*] Unlimited Respawns: No more using stamps to respawn. Keep the adventure going!
[*] Add Assist Elements: Extra platforms to ease difficult sections and hints for mandatory puzzles.
[*] Highlight Pickup Items: Beams of light make every gift and key easier to find.
[*] Timeless Challenges: Remove timers from all time-based challenges for a relaxed pace.
[*] Power-Up Shield: Keep your power-ups safe even when taking damage.
[*] Game Over Shop: Choose any power-up from the shop when you die instead of getting a random one.
[/list]
[h3][h2]Multiplayer Lobby Fun 🎉[/h2][/h3]
[list]
[*] Shooting Challenge: Compete with friends to shoot all targets in the best time.
[*] Musical Instruments: Jam out and create tunes together.
[*] Hide and Seek with the Rabbit: Find the rabbit character in the lobby. It will hide again once found!
[/list]

[h2]Improvements 🛠️[/h2]
[list]
[*] Redesigned Game Over Screen: Improved button layout for better clarity and usability.
[*] Random Power-Up Selection: Let the slot machine choose your power-up and enjoy the surprise of what you get!
[*] Balanced Game Sets in Multiplayer: Ensures a more even distribution of game modes by selecting three different random game modes first, then choosing corresponding random levels.
[*] Minor Performance Optimizations: Smoother gameplay experience.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes 🔧[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved White Noise Flickering: No more distracting flickering on edges.
[/list]

We can’t wait to hear your feedback. Happy gaming!
🎮 The Stilt Team

notes.title: Exciting News and Update for Stilt Players! 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Stilt players![/b]
We are thrilled by the amazing community that has formed around our game. Your passion and dedication inspire us every day. If you’ve been enjoying your time with Stilt, we would love to hear from you! Your reviews help us improve the game and bring in new players. Please take a moment to leave us a review on store pages and let us know what you think!

[h1]Big Update Coming July 11th: Assist Mode and More! [/h1]
We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we are excited to announce a major update arriving on July 11th. This update will make Stilt even more enjoyable for all types of players. Here’s what you can look forward to:

[h2]Customize Your Challenge with Assist Mode[/h2]
We know some of you love the challenge that Stilt offers, and we appreciate that! However, we also understand that some players are looking for a more relaxed way to explore our exciting maps. That’s why we’re introducing Assist Mode – where you can control the challenge with the following assist elements. You can choose the elements you want, using one or many:

[list]
[*] Unlimited Respawns: No need to use stamps to respawn.
[*] Add Assist Elements: Adds extra platforms to the level, making hard sections easier. It also adds some hints to non-optional puzzles.
[*] Highlight Pickup Items: Adds a beam from every gift and key to make them easier to see.
[*] Timeless Challenges: Removes the timer from all time-based challenges.
[*] Power-Up Shield: Disables the loss of power-ups when taking damage.
[*] Game Over Shop: Replaces the random power-up you can buy when you die with a shop where you can buy whichever power-up you please.
[/list]

[h2]New Fun Activities in the Multiplayer Lobby [/h2]
Our multiplayer lobby is getting new fun things to do! Here’s what’s coming:

[list]
[*] Hide and Seek Character: Who can find the hidden character first? 
[*] Shooting Challenge: Test your skills and compete with friends! 
[/list]

This update is designed to make your time in the lobby as enjoyable as your adventures in the game.
Stay Tuned! 

Mark your calendars for July 11th, and stay tuned for more updates! We can’t wait for you to try out the new features and share your thoughts with us.

Thank you for being part of the Stilt community. Your support means the world to us.
Happy gaming! 

The Stilt Team

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0 - Dressing up
notes.content:
Hello, it's time for another patch. This week we're bringing some totally free cosmetics for you to customize your avatar. Now your friends will recognize you better in the multiplayer arenas. However, the cosmetics are hidden in each of the single-player levels. Can you find them all?

Another visual addition is the mouth sync. Your avatar will move it's mouth while you're talking to your headset mic.

Find the full list of changes and improvements below.


[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added ability to dress up the player with different cosmetic options.
[*] Added 20 findable cosmetics, one hidden in each level.
[*] Players' mouths now move to match your voice in multiplayer,
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enhanced in-game UI interaction: you can now point and shoot at buttons within a certain area, in addition to physically clicking them.
[*] Rearranged the main menu buttons to reduce clutter.
[/list]

Have you found any bugs, got some feedback or want to find friends to play with? [url=https://discord.gg/Z9C5yfNGHe]Join Stilt's official Discord![/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0: Friends Without Borders
notes.content:
No more stuck to one place, cross-region is now available!
Join your friends around the world and explore the new level, Split Valley Woods!

Full release notes:
1.1.0
[b]General Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b][New Feature][/b] Players can now choose their server region, either in the settings menu or within the group up room, providing greater control over matchmaking and connectivity.
[*] [b][New Feature] [/b]Introducing a new multiplayer level: Split Valley Woods. Explore this exciting new environment with friends in multiplayer mode.
[*] [b][Fix][/b] Addressed minor level issues and implemented internal system enhancements for improved gameplay stability.
[*] [b][Fix] [/b]Corrected an issue where appear spikes causing damage did not align correctly with visual cues before initial strike.
[*] [b][Fix] [/b]Resolved an exploit where players could become invulnerable by pausing the game immediately after taking damage.
[*] [b][Fix] [/b]Resolved an issue where pausing during fog transitions into arena gameplay could cause the transition to become stuck.
[*] [b][Potential Fix][/b] Investigated and addressed reports of players falling through the floor upon respawning at the boss level. Further testing is ongoing to confirm the effectiveness of the solution.[/list]

notes.title: Trimming the details: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
No more green screen, patch 1.0.1 is here!
We heard your feedback and we fixed some recurring issues and some bugs. 

General Changes:
[b][Improvement][/b] Reimagined the visual effect when players are within bushes or trees. Instead of completely obstructing vision, the effect now conceals the object while displaying a transparent overlay, accompanied by a particle effect of leaves.
[b][Improvement] [/b]Implemented controller vibration feedback for power-up activations.
[b][New Feature][/b] Introduced an option to restart a level directly from the pause menu.
[b][Fix][/b] Fixed issue where achievement "Don't Look Down" was not triggered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336768/ab68f2b3429ef2ebac6be23aa28b7c238fc82173.gif[/img]

As usual, thanks to everyone who gave their feedback!
You can always contact us and report some issues (or tell us what you liked!) on [url=https://discord.gg/C7ZhuHV8z8]our official Discord server![/url]

notes.title: Good news, everyone! Updates from the dev 🌴
notes.content:
Hello everyone! A late happy 2024 with some news from our side.

First of all, the release date! In case you missed it, [b]Stilt will release on the 8th of March![/b] 🌴

We have been a bit quiet recently, so this is what we worked on: 

[list]
[*] [b]We have updated the story and main theme of the game[/b], changed some of the more generic story elements and made Stilt a bit more special. You are now a delivery person that needs to retrieve lost cargo.
[*] [b]All the levels have been finished. [/b]They all also got a face lift with new decorative items and some of them will have a new look. The new theme is a sky theme that will look like it belongs high up in the mountains and in the sky.
[*] We added lots of small improvements and some new options, like [b]comfort settings[/b] for those who easily get motion sick.
[*] [b]We removed the time limit for the levels.[/b] The time limit feature did not turn out the effect we planned and after seeing people interacting with the game we decided to cut it out to let players explore the levels at their own pace.

[*] [b]We added multiplayer to the game![/b]
It will consist of 4 game modes plus an interactable lobby where you can hang out and roam freely.
[*] To make players stand out in multiplayer they can change the colour of their character.
[*] We have also updated the style of all the enemies to make them stand out a bit more now with help from our new employee.
[*] A lot of 3D models and textures have also gotten small retouches to improve the visual quality.

[*] [b]We added a streamer mode[/b], making the visuals and movement of the camera more pleasant for 2d content.
[*] We have a [b]full new soundtrack[/b] for the game with music specially designed for Stilt.
[/list]

In these less two months we will be ironing out all the kinks, polish everything, and focusing on fixing bugs to have a great launch time!
Join us on Discord if you want to leave some feedback and meet other players! -> [url=https://discord.gg/r8bfq4CNHU]Stilt on Discord[/url]
